Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 2

Iconic Paired Cyberarm Options. Needs paired Cyberarms and 2 Cyberarm Option Slots in each, and counts as two installations of Borgware. Each arm gains a One-Handed Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon that hides with no check and deploys or stows for free; the hand on a popped-up arm can't hold anything. With both blades out the user may swing them together as a single Excellent Quality ROF 2 Very Heavy Melee Weapon reaching 4m/yds, and the usual climbing movement penalty goes away. Whenever either blade lands a Critical Injury, roll three times on the table and pick the one the victim suffers. With Speedware active and a total initiative bonus of +4 or better, any damage die from these blades that comes up 1 is re-rolled until it doesn't.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • One item for the pair, as Corgo installs them together. Its size is the 2 slots it takes in one arm; it needs 2 in each.
  • Counts as two installations of Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss, applied by hand.
  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
